Configure PaddleOCR language, model tier, and model version

```dart title="Dart"
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:xberg/xberg.dart';
import 'package:xberg/src/xberg_bridge_generated/frb_generated.dart' show RustLib;
Future<void> main() async {
  await RustLib.init();
  try {
    final input = await createExtractInputFromJson(json: '{"kind":"uri","mime_type":"image/png","uri":"https://example.com/images/test_hello_world.png"}');
    final config = await createExtractionConfigFromJson(json: '{"ocr":{"backend":"paddleocr","enabled":true,"language":["en"],"paddle_ocr_config":{"language":"en","model_tier":"mobile","model_version":"pp-ocrv6"}}}');
    final result = await XbergBridge.extract(input, config: config);
    stdout.writeln(result.results[0].content);
  } finally {
    RustLib.dispose();
  }
}
```
